essence: The "with children" total never arrives on the session page; after 2 minutes on the main site it still reads "with children …", in the stats bar and in every Overview group. `AICost.ask` POSTs `{path:<session url>, delta:{summary:{}}}` to /api/item, and for sessions like d9c3caec Servex appends it as a plain line `{"summary":{},"by":"owner"}` to `session-d9c3caec/page.jsonl` (6 lines there, 13 across 3 gitignored page logs since 2026-10-24) and returns no `answer.summary`. Reproduce: `curl -X POST http://servex.localhost/api/item -d '{"path":"/framework/ai/sessions/d9c3caec-e496-4199-a0c1-a7bb7c97aa87/","delta":{"summary":{}}}'`.
fix: Have the item tool resolve a session url to the class that defines `summary` (the session record), never fall back to a page.jsonl assignment for a method-shaped key. Then delete the stray `{"summary":{}}` lines.
